description: Sample player with 32 cue markers: markers are placed on the waveform and each fires its own trigger output as playback passes it

params.text: Selects that marker number, so a marker placed on the waveform belongs to it and fires its output; one at a time is lit
Starts playback from the position the playhead has reached
Stops playback, leaving the playhead where it is
Returns the playhead to the start of the sample

inputs.text: A rising edge returns the playhead to the start of the sample

outputs.text: The left channel of the sample, -5V to 5V
The right channel of the sample, -5V to 5V
A 10V trigger as the playhead passes a marker belonging to that number, 1ms long unless the menu says otherwise

notes: the outputs stay silent until a WAV file is loaded, with the item under the Sample label in the right-click menu
double-click the large waveform to add a marker for the selected number, and double-click a marker to delete it
drag the large waveform sideways to move the view along the sample, drag a marker to move it, and drag the playhead to move the playback position
the scroll wheel over the large waveform zooms the view in and out around the pointer
right-click the large waveform for Clear All Markers and Add Marker; right-click a marker for Delete Marker
menu: Sample — the item under this label loads the WAV file, and prints the filename it holds
Trigger Length — how long every marker pulse lasts, from 1ms to 200ms
Place markers at divisions — spreads markers evenly through the sample, at 4, 8, 16 or 32 of them
Loop sample playback — returns to the start at the end of the sample instead of stopping
Lock Markers — stops markers being added, moved or deleted
Enable Vertical-Drag Zoom — makes a drag up or down on the large waveform zoom the view as the drag sideways moves it
Interpolation — Off, or Linear (Better Quality), choosing how the samples between two stored samples are worked out
Clear All Markers — removes every marker
Lock Mouse Interaction — stops the waveform responding to the mouse at all
Clear markers on sample load — empties the markers whenever a new file is loaded

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
